snippet.title: Kinniku Banzuke - ROAD TO SASUKE - First Stage (Training Mode)
snippet.description:
Since the ps3 is in the shop, I thought about busting out the old playstation and some kinniku banzuke. training mode is alot eaiser then the real game, since you have to upgrade your character stats to pass the first stage (also, i know very little japanese!) in training mode, your character is in pretty good shape, so its alot easier passing the 1st stage.

EDIT: since people have been asking where to download this game, you may find it over at the forums at http://sasukemaniac.com, all sasuke related news and videos galore!
